description: Read recent posts from one public Facebook group. Get post text, URLs, dates, group title and reaction, comment and share counts as JSON. Use it to research recurring questions and discussion topics. Member profiles and nested comments are not returned. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

limit.description: number of posts wanted, 1 to 20 (default 5). A larger value is lowered to 20 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

name: facebook-group-posts
title: Public Facebook group posts
